What are some of the best google chrome extensions to have?
I'd add HTTPS Everywhere for the security concious of us, and SmoothScroll its the one thing I miss from Firefox.

If you use Facebook - F.B Purity

uBlock Origin

Pushbullet

Lastpass

FlashControl

Magic Actions for Youtube

The Great Suspender

I use those and they make my life so much easier.

Pushbullet. Amazing for seeing and reacting to my phone's notifications on my PC, as well as for pushing links to my phone.

Tampermonkey + YouTube Center. I use this for forcing YouTube to load in 1080p right from the beginning, instead of relying on the auto setting to get my bandwidth right or having to change it manually. YouTube Center has tons of other options for customising YouTube, and Tampermonkey is great for userscripts that aren't standalone extensions. There are other YouTube tweakers, and YouTube Center is also on the webstore as a standalone extension - but the userscript version is the most full featured (it has a downloader which the web store version isn't allowed to include).

If you use Google Play Music, then Play Midnight is a gorgeous dark theme that'll save your eyes.

Along a similar vein, Dark Reader is the best extension for darkening any other web page for the same reason. It doesn't just invert the colours - images are not inverted, but are desaturated and made dimmer.

Slighty more obscure - Steam Inventory Helper. Bulk sell items in your inventory. I had ~250 trading cards in there. I could just select them all, tell this extension to put them on the market for a penny less than average price and they all got sold within 15 minutes. Made ~£11 that I spent in the Summer sale. Literally free money.
